title: Registry Query of Disk Enum Hardware Key for VM Discovery
id: cc1f4ae3-6892-43ba-aa5d-f4c62f5edde6

description: 'Suspicious Process Creation: cmd.exe Spawning reg.exe - Host WIN-5J23U7CAV7V.hvan.vn

  score=0.7943): Image=reg.exe, ParentImage=cmd.exe, CommandLine=reg  query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControl'
references:
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1012/
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/003/
author: SigmaGen
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1012
- attack.t1059.003
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:

    ParentImage|endswith: \cmd.exe

    - Services\Disk\Enum
  condition: selection
falsepositives:

level: high
